# FabriCAD-format test fixture

These files were written by hand for SCMPA's tests in the *file format* of FabriCAD (semicolon-separated CSV,
German column names; see https://github.com/CIMTT-Kiel/FabriCAD/blob/main/data/README.md).
They contain **no FabriCAD data**: the IDs (900000xx), values and feature texts are invented.
